The claim does not infer \(L=\pi\) merely from the weaker congruence modulo \(2\pi\).

value.rationale: The source flags a genuine short-branch issue: odd spherical monodromy determines length only modulo \(2\pi\), and exact \(\pi\) required a separate chord-budget proof in its nonsymmetric period-five example. The midpoint computation resolves that issue uniformly for the canonical regular spherical member of every odd period and transfers the exact value to its open primitive component. This is a structural all-odd statement tied directly to the paper's main family, not an arbitrary parameter slice or numerical refinement.
